name: Microsoft Graph Mail
description: Read Outlook/Microsoft 365 mail through Microsoft Graph: profile, messages, message details, search, and attachments. 6 tools, built-in OAuth2 auth.
instructions:
This connector uses Microsoft Graph API v1.0 mail endpoints with the built-in AnythingMCP OAuth2 authorization-code flow.

**Setup**:
1. Register an app in Microsoft Entra ID at https://portal.azure.com → **App registrations → New registration**.
2. Add a Web redirect URI: `<your SERVER_URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` (for local Docker, usually `http://localhost:4000/api/mcp-oauth/callback`).
3. Create a client secret under **Certificates & secrets**.
4. Add Microsoft Graph delegated permissions: `User.Read`, `Mail.Read`, and `offline_access`. Grant admin consent if your tenant requires it.
5. Set:
   - `MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TENANT_ID` = your tenant ID, or `common` for multi-tenant/work-personal sign-in
   - `MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID` = app/client ID
   - `MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET` = client secret value
6. Import this adapter, then run the one-time OAuth flow: `POST /api/connectors/{id}/oauth/authorize` → open the returned URL → sign in and consent. AnythingMCP stores the encrypted access/refresh tokens and refreshes them automatically.

**Authentication**: OAuth2. Requests send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` automatically after the OAuth callback succeeds.

**Mailbox scope**: these tools use `/me`, so delegated tokens read the signed-in user's mailbox. For shared mailboxes or app-only tenant access, create a dedicated connector variant using `/users/{userId}`.

**Pagination**: list/search calls return OData `@odata.nextLink` when more results exist. Use `$top` to keep responses small.

**Search**: `microsoft_graph_mail_search_emails` maps to Graph's `$search` query. Pass a Graph-compatible search string, usually quoted for plain text, for example `"quarterly report"`, or use property terms such as `from:alice@example.com subject:invoice`.

**Attachments**: `microsoft_graph_mail_get_email_attachment` decodes Graph `contentBytes` server-side. PDFs are converted to extracted plain text when possible, text-like files are returned as text, images are returned as MCP image blocks, and other binaries are saved to disk with a file reference. Raw base64 is never returned in a text block.

**Rate limits**: Microsoft Graph throttles per app, tenant, and mailbox. On 429 honor `Retry-After`.

**Out of scope here**: sending mail, modifying mail, delta sync, subscriptions/webhooks, MIME `$value` downloads, shared mailbox `/users/{id}` operations.

tools.name: microsoft_graph_mail_get_profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in Microsoft 365 user's profile: id, displayName, mail, userPrincipalName, jobTitle, mobilePhone, officeLocation, preferredLanguage.

tools.name: microsoft_graph_mail_read_emails
tools.description: List recent messages in the signed-in user's mailbox. Use $select to reduce payload size and $filter/$orderby for OData narrowing. When $select is omitted, Graph returns its default message projection.

$top.description: Maximum messages to return in one page. Graph commonly supports up to 1000; 10-50 is recommended for agents.

$select.description: Comma-separated fields. Default includes id, subject, from, receivedDateTime, hasAttachments, isRead, importance, webLink, bodyPreview.

$filter.description: OData filter, e.g. receivedDateTime ge 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z or isRead eq false.

$skip.description: Number of messages to skip for offset-style pagination when supported.

tools.name: microsoft_graph_mail_get_email_details
tools.description: Get one email message by ID, including headers/body if requested via $select.

tools.name: microsoft_graph_mail_search_emails
tools.description: Search mailbox messages with Microsoft Graph $search. Pass a Graph-compatible search string, e.g. "\"quarterly report\"" or "from:alice@example.com subject:invoice".

$search.description: Graph search expression. Quote plain text terms, e.g. "quarterly report".

$top.description: Maximum messages to return in one page.

tools.name: microsoft_graph_mail_list_email_attachments
tools.description: List attachment metadata for one email message. Any Graph contentBytes field is stripped before returning so raw base64 is not exposed as text.

$top.description: Maximum attachments to return in one page.

tools.name: microsoft_graph_mail_get_email_attachment
tools.description: Get one attachment by ID from an email message. The server decodes Graph contentBytes: PDFs become extracted text, text-like files become text, images become MCP image blocks, and other binaries are saved with a file reference.
